name: microstock-plus
description: Manage Microstock+ portfolio files, previews, metadata, uploads and CSV exports without deletion or paid AI actions.

interface.longDescription: Find and inspect portfolio files, open preview links, safely edit metadata, initialize direct uploads, export CSV and follow account events. File deletion and paid AI actions are unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Audit my newest Microstock+ folder for missing metadata.
Show previews for files that need keywords, then propose fixes.
Upload this local file to my selected Microstock+ folder.
Export this folder's metadata as CSV.
